text: Global Standard: Foundry pricing matches Fireworks Direct Global Priority. The 25% premium over Fireworks Direct Global Standard reflects the difference in serving priority, not an additional Foundry markup.

text: Improved reliability under load: Requests are less likely to be rejected due to server overload (HTTP 503).

text: In September 2026, Fireworks introduced new pricing tiers based on deployment geography (Global/US) and service priority (Standard/Priority). This change allows Foundry prices to map directly to corresponding Fireworks Direct prices for most newly onboarded models.
text: Last updated on 2026-11-24

text: Standard has different meanings in Foundry and Fireworks Direct. In Foundry, it refers to a deployment type, while in Fireworks Direct, it refers to a serverless serving mode. These terms aren't interchangeable.
text: Under the current pricing arrangement, future pricing updates apply only to newly onboarded models and don't affect the existing prices of models already available in Foundry.

text: While Fireworks Standard is generally suited for individual developers and smaller workloads, Priority is better suited for enterprise applications that require more consistent availability during periods of high demand.
